summary: Backend: 9/9 pytest cases PASS (root, products list/detail/404, RFQ create+list+validation+invalid email, Contact create+list+validation). Frontend: home loads with full hero/CTAs; nav to all 5 pages works; /products renders 6 product cards with data-testid product-card-<id>; clicking card navigates to /products/:id detail; mobile menu (data-testid mobile-menu-btn) opens drawer with 6 nav links; RFQ and Contact forms render with required data-testid (rfq-form, rfq-submit, contact-form, contact-submit). MongoDB _id never leaks. Email integration intentionally MOCKED (deferred).

integration_issues.issue: Test could not auto-verify success state because Product is a custom Radix Select (not native <select>). Manual interaction expected to work; needs follow-up E2E with Radix-aware selector. Form fields, validation, and POST endpoint all verified independently via backend tests.
Submit click did not surface a success keyword (thank/success/sent) in body within 2.5s — may be due to async or different success copy. Backend POST /api/contact verified working via pytest.

issues: HTML <title> is the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be branded (e.g., 'ق stones — Himalayan Pink Salt Exporter') for SEO and tab UX.

action_items: Update document <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html (or set per-route via react-helmet) to brand 'ق stones'.
(Optional, low priority) Confirm RFQ/Contact UI success-state copy and consider exposing data-testid='rfq-success' and 'contact-success' for deterministic E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Date stored as ISO string then re-parsed on list — fine but inconsistent with native BSON datetime. Acceptable for MVP.
server.py correctly excludes _id via projection {"_id": 0} on both list endpoints — good.
Email integration is intentionally MOCKED/deferred (placeholder comment in /api/rfq) — confirmed by problem statement.
CORS is wide-open ('*'); acceptable for preview but tighten before prod.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed RFQ and Contact docs into MongoDB (test_database). Not cleaned up — low volume, acceptable for MVP iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 product IDs: edible-salt, salt-lamps, bath-salt, salt-bricks, animal-licks, gourmet-grinder. Backend public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_qstones_api.py — reuse for regression. RFQ form uses Radix Select for Product — Playwright needs role='combobox'/option clicks, not select_option. Site title is unbranded default; only doc-level concern.
